title: Temporary connection.
officialText:
The commissioner shall have the authority to authorize the temporary connection of a mechanical
system to the sources of energy for the purpose of testing mechanical systems or for use under a temporary certificate of occupancy.
SECTION MC 108
VIOLATIONS
